incident.title: slots booking flow: expect(locator).toHaveText(expected) failed — on getByTestId('book-status'), expected "200", element(s) not found
incident.description:
Error: expect(locator).toHaveText(expected) failed

Locator: getByTestId('book-status')
Expected: "200"
Timeout: 10000ms
Error: element(s) not found

Call log:
  - Expect "toHaveText" getByTestId('book-status') with timeout 10000ms
  - waiting for getByTestId('book-status')


  34 |
  35 |     // 3. booking answered 200
> 36 |     await expect(page.getByTestId('book-status')).toHaveText('200')
     |                                                   ^
  37 |
  38 |     // 4. booking confirmed
  39 |     await expect(page.getByTestId('booking-result')).toHaveText('CONFIRMED')
    at /tmp/playwright-ConAB2/user/tests/booking.spec.ts:36:51

Rocky RCA (UNKNOWN_ERROR): The check failed because the assertion `expect(page.getByTestId('book-status')).toHaveText('200')` timed out after 10 seconds without ever finding an element with `data-testid="book-status"`, but the available trace cannot be inspected due to a Playwright version mismatch, so it is unclear whether this is caused by a test locator issue or by the application not rendering the element. The flow passed earlier the same day from another region, indicating a recent or intermittent change in either the UI behavior or environment that prevents the `book-status` element from appearing in this run.

rca.rootCause: The check failed because the assertion `expect(page.getByTestId('book-status')).toHaveText('200')` timed out after 10 seconds without ever finding an element with `data-testid="book-status"`, but the available trace cannot be inspected due to a Playwright version mismatch, so it is unclear whether this is caused by a test locator issue or by the application not rendering the element. The flow passed earlier the same day from another region, indicating a recent or intermittent change in either the UI behavior or environment that prevents the `book-status` element from appearing in this run.
rca.userImpact: Users attempting to book a slot may not see the booking status update to a success code, and the booking confirmation step may not complete as expected. This could manifest as bookings appearing stuck or unconfirmed after submission.

evidence.description: The error log shows a `toHaveText` expectation on `getByTestId('book-status')` failing with `element(s) not found` after 10s, pinpointing the symptom: the `book-status` element did not exist in the DOM when expected.

The trace file cannot be analyzed because it was recorded with a newer Playwright version than the available viewer, so we cannot see DOM snapshots, network calls, or near-miss locators to distinguish between a locator drift vs. UI/backend failure.

The last passing run from a few hours earlier in `us-east-1` confirms that the same check can succeed, but detailed step data is no longer retained, so we cannot directly compare the DOM or network behavior at the `book-status` step.
